visualCharacteristics.purpose: Service finder input that filters the cards-product cards on the same page as the user types
visualCharacteristics.description: Large outlined search input with magnifier icon; horizontal track of 11 round icon chips with labels (Destaques selected, light blue); count line '10 servicos disponiveis'; 3-column grid of bordered product cards with image, optional badge (NOVIDADE / Compre e Ganhe!), category eyebrow, title, price label + price, optional instalment text, grey benefit box (20% de desconto com Cartao Porto Bank) and full-width blue 'Compre agora' button.

contentPattern.structure: optional row with a query-index URL (/servicos/query-index.json), used only when the page has no cards-product block (shows a link dropdown instead); optional row with the placeholder text (default: "Encontre o serviço que precisa")
contentPattern.source: Single row: query index URL for services (e.g. /servicos/query-index.json); placeholder 'Encontre o serviço que precisa' as a second paragraph if supported. Filters the product cards below.

usage: Place above cards-category and cards-product in the service listing section. Text search spans all categories.
reuseGuidance: Reuse on any listing page that has a cards-product block. Communicates via the document event `services:search`.
